name: Night Realm
source:
"I did nothing wrong... But why does everyone hate me?"

"Come, Let the wishing well hear your story. It will help you with your problems"

Every day, more and more students disappeared from existence. However, it's not their concern. They are finding a way to search for their father's whereabouts. 

One night, they are pulled into another world and they didn't know a way back home. Maybe it's a punishment for being ignorant and indifferent to other people?

Luckily there is someone who fell from the locker. Maybe. Maybe today. Things will change... Maybe this is a chance.

Can they find a way to go back to their world?

[From [url=https://verian12.itch.io/night-realm]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“我什么都没做错…为什么大家都讨厌我？”

“来吧，把你的故事讲给许愿井听。它会帮你解决烦恼。”

每天，都有越来越多的学生凭空消失。但主角并不在意这些，只想找到父亲的下落。

某天夜里，主角被拉进另一个世界，却不知道回家的路。或许，这是对无知与漠视他人的惩罚？

幸好，有个人从储物柜里掉了出来。也许。也许就在今天。事情会有所改变…也许，这是一个机会。

主角能找到返回原来世界的方法吗？

[摘自[url=https://verian12.itch.io/night-realm]Itch.io[/url]]
